items.claim: Cluster drag hangs on a cluster loop, from `dragEdit`'s `depth`
`parentsOf` takes the last cluster naming a member, where the rest of diagram takes the first
`checkPipeline` does not report a member that two clusters name
items.note: This adds a new problem kind, `duplicate-member`, which is a `minor` changeset, and a README table row.

items.claim: Two wires sharing an `id` make `EffectChart`/`EffectEditor` throw during render
items.note: A repeated id is now drawn without the id and reported as `duplicate-wire`, also a `minor` changeset.

items.claim: `applySets` stops at the first failed param write but the plan still records the later writes as applied
A node whose `build` throws freezes the live graph and names no stage
One wire into a port its node lacks rolls the whole live graph back
items.note: Strict call recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: only the bad edge is cut, and the error goes on the stage it enters.

items.claim: `sync` assumes a structural apply that throws changed nothing, though `graph.apply` keeps applying after an execution-time failure
A `pause()` or `reset()` during `play()`'s unlock is undone once the unlock resolves
`useFollowAudioRunner` never passes the runner `sources` that went back to `undefined`
Shipped audio nodes throw at build, not in `settings`, for a missing or unknown discrete setting
items.note: A missing setting now takes the stage type's default; recorded in `docs/unruled.md`. To check values in `settings`, `@weasel-js/audio` now exports `checkWave`, `checkFilterType` and `checkNoiseColor`, which is a `minor` changeset on audio. Reverb `seconds` ≤ 0 is still caught at build, but the build fix above now turns that into an error on the stage.
